constants.background: real photograph or footage on 20 of 20 (#9 is a diagram laid over a road photo)
constants.host_face: none of 20 show the channel host
constants.headline_text: 12 of 20 carry headline text, all white heavy or condensed sans with one red accent word
constants.boxes_and_strokes: no text boxes, no solid bars, no strokes; dark shadow or glow on most
constants.badges_logos_borders: no channel logo, badge, border or frame on any thumbnail
constants.grade: dark, low-saturation, often near black; black-and-white on #2, #7 and #10

channel_findings.host_treatment: Not used. 0 of 20 thumbnails show the channel host. The only person is #19: a runner (other person), about 5% of frame width, left and middle, full body, head turned back toward the tornado, no cutout or glow. Share of thumbnails with the host's face: 0 of 20 (0%).

text_rules.word_count: 3 to 9 words on the 12 headline thumbs; median 4
text_rules.case: mixed case on 9 of 12; all caps on #10 and #18; caps line with small-caps subline on #5
text_rules.colours: white base with one red accent on 12 of 12
text_rules.highlight: the red word is the payoff: a rating on 4 of 12 (#4, #5, #7, #10); a count on 2 of 12 (#2, #20); a superlative or stake word on 3 of 12 (#18 STRONGEST, #3 DEATH, #1 warning); a place name or title phrase on 3 of 12 (#6, #8, #16)
text_rules.lines: 1 line on #1 and #2; 2 lines on 9 thumbs; 3 lines on #18

channel_findings.popular_vs_latest: Popular (#1 to #10): 9 of 10 carry headline text; 4 use the top-band headline (T2), 3 the stacked right headline (T1), 2 the top and bottom split (T3), 1 a diagram (T5). Median views 996000. Latest (#11 to #20): 7 of 10 have no text (T4); 3 have headlines (#16, #18, #20). Median views 869000. Latest holds the top three views (11.0M, 5.5M, 4.3M); popular peaks at 3.5M. Latest has the lowest-view thumb overall (#13, 245000).
channel_findings.top3: #18 Smithville (11000000): dark tornado over ordinary houses, red 'STRONGEST' headline. #14 (5500000): no text, debris cloud inside a tornado over a green field. #16 Greensburg (4300000): dark VHS-grain tornado with red place name and 2007. Shared: all three are 'latest' uploads; a large dark storm or debris cloud fills the frame; no host face; two of three use a red superlative or place-year headline, one (#14) uses none.
transfer: Headline of 3 to 5 words in white heavy sans with one red payoff word. Evidence: 12 of 12 headline thumbs use this pattern; #18 (11000000 views) uses red 'STRONGEST', #16 (4300000) red 'Greensburg Tornado'.

Stack a number with its noun in two lines on the right third, the red line as the payoff. Evidence: #4 '1 year / 6 EF5s' (1600000 views), #20 '1 year / 1817 tornadoes' (424000), #3 '30 seconds from DEATH' (2000000).
Make the red word a rating or a superlative. Evidence: EF ratings appear in 4 of 12 headlines (#4, #5, #7, #10); the superlative in #18 (11000000 views) is the top thumbnail.

Put a real damaged home or town in the frame for scale. Evidence: #18 has ranch houses at the base (11000000 views); #1 is an aerial view of a flattened subdivision (3500000 views). Counter-evidence: #11 has house damage and no text (313000 views).
Test a presenter face against a no-face control rather than assuming it helps. Evidence: 0 of 20 show the host; the top three (#18, #14, #16) have no host, and #14 (5500000 views) has no text at all.
weak: #13 'My Most Insane Tornado Intercepts' (245000 views, lowest in set): no text, a small pickup and a mid-frame tornado with low contrast; nothing in the thumbnail states the claim.
#9 'How Do Supercell Thunderstorms Work?' (302000 views): the labels (FLC, UB, RFD, FFD) are too small to read at phone size; no headline and no focal point.

#6 'OVER 2 MILES WIDE - The Bassfield-Soso EF4 Tornado' (592000 views): the thumbnail text reads '2020 Easter Tornado Outbreak', which does not match the title. The image promises a different video; likely a wrong thumbnail or title on the upload.
